eventTemplate.title: [Camunda Platform] ArchiverBacklogGrowing
eventTemplate.description:
Archiver backlog has been non-zero for 2 hours on partition {dims} — potential archival bottleneck.

The source rule also required the backlog to not be shrinking (delta over the last 10m >= 0); a STATIC_THRESHOLD metric event can't express that trend check, so this fires on "backlog > 0 for 2h" alone, same simplification as datadog_alerts/ made — verify archival is actually stuck (not just slow) before acting.

Caveat: zeebe_camunda_exporter_process_instances_awaiting_archival is not in metric-mapping-8.7.md's verified table (out of scope for that dashboard-focused exercise). The dotted key is inferred by the same convention used for every other zeebe_* gauge/counter in that table — verify it exists in your tenant before relying on it.
